fin_count_profile.qualification: FIN intersects full channel x span and is fully contained in active y interval; partial fin is unsupported, never rounded
fin_count_profile.count: distinct qualified FIN rectangles for each recognized channel, grouped by the one-to-one device identity join

device_extraction_contract.sd_policy: left connected component of OD minus channel is S, right is D; ordered terminals, swap unsupported
device_extraction_contract.body_operator: one same-type local body enclosing active; local graph separate; selected bound read-only external tapcell context supports body-to-rail association by exact geometry; no implicit edge from names
device_extraction_contract.gate_operator: POLY conductor continuous through channels; never an OD S-to-D conductor edge

body_context_profile.coordinates: source local frame; integer nominal nm; identity transform only
body_context_profile.source_binding: actual source GDS bytes, top, FRAME and exact body/rail object identities required

operators.rectangle_set_difference/1: exact set subtraction, retain all positive-area rectangles, split disconnected results
operators.same_layer_contact/1: positive-area overlap OR positive-length shared edge; corner/point touch never edge
operators.cross_layer_contact/1: connector positive-area overlap with exactly one region in each declared conductor layer; no via-as-wire duplication; enclosure independently mandatory
operators.terminal_split/1: effective OD minus recognized channel; device S/D relation never union
operators.spacing/1: Euclidean minimum separation of closed exact rectangles; compare squared integer distance with squared threshold; geometry_only has no label exemption
operators.lifecycle/1: all preserve_drawn elements retain drawn signatures; frame_static also binds frame signature; no prepublication_derived layer in this profile; operator DAG effective geometry -> fragments -> contacts/body -> terminal graph -> mandatory rules
